exposure: Consumption of a single cup of filtered coffee two hours before spinal anesthesia
cohort: The study included 140 patients undergoing elective cesarean section with spinal anesthesia, divided into a coffee group and a control group.
finding: Consumption of a single cup of coffee before spinal anesthesia significantly reduced the incidence of intraoperative hypotension, the rate of ephedrine usage, and the incidence of post-dural puncture headache in patients undergoing elective cesarean sections.
